title: Nvidia closes below $4T market cap for first time since July 2025 in Huang fallout
summary: Nvidia has experienced a significant market shift, closing below a $4 trillion market cap for the first time since July 2025. This downturn follows the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang, who stepped down amid scrutiny over personal controversies, including allegations of extramarital affairs. The impact of Huang's departure raises questions about the future leadership and direction of the company in a highly competitive tech landscape.
